name: Fly-HDMI7
description: A 7 inch IPS HDMI capacitive touchscreen display with USB-C touch interface and 3.5mm headphone jack. Supports direct FPC connection to FLY host boards as well as standard HDMI cable connection to any SBC. Features tempered glass and 500 nits brightness.

connectionSpecs.connector: Mini HDMI + USB-C (or FPC direct-connect to FLY boards)

features: FPC direct-connect to FLY host boards
Standard HDMI connection for any SBC
